about.p1: I'm Rosario, a Full Stack Developer with a degree in Programming from UTN FRGP. I build production apps end-to-end — from architecture to deploy — using React Native, Firebase and Node.js.
about.p2: I worked as a Junior Developer at Body Health SA, developing and maintaining web apps with React, integrating REST APIs, and resolving complex bugs including memory leaks. Before that, I led an 8-person team for 3 years.
about.p3: I'm methodical, self-managed and comfortable in both remote and on-site environments. Currently deepening my TypeScript skills while actively looking for new opportunities.
